findings.finding: Specification compliance: Full alignment with defect-records, ultrafixer-dispatch, and dependencies-defects delta specifications across schema v8 DDL, ledger Go CRUD API, CLI defect subcommands, packet template asset, and coordination reference.

Design fidelity: Zero new Go dispatch plumbing verified. Capability reuses internal/packet/packet.go, internal/executor/agy.go, internal/run/batch.go, and worktree isolation verbatim, with dispatch orchestrated purely via ultrafixer-packet-template.md and dependencies-defects.md protocol.
findings.evidence: openspec/changes/ultrafixer/design.md:18-24; git diff 8f78625~1..d5feeb4 shows no modifications to internal/run/, internal/executor/, or production internal/packet/ code

findings.finding: Schema v8 migration and constraints: Migration is strictly idempotent across database reopens and upgrades. defect_records table enforces SQLite STRICT typing and CHECK (disposition IN ('recorded','repaired','declined','deferred')), indexed by (feature_id, id).

Worktree safety guards: CLI defect subcommands (record, list) verify repository root and reject invocation from inside linked worktrees via worktree.IsLinkedWorktree, maintaining consistency with existing ledger-mutating CLI subcommands.

Test quality: All new unit and integration tests assert against terminal artifacts (actual SQLite database rows, table PRAGMA strict flags, CLI stdout/stderr formatting, and parsed packet structures) rather than mocks or tautologies.
